newsitem.title: FINLAND: Huhtamaki targets 40 pct dividend - CEO.
newsitem.headline: Huhtamaki targets 40 pct dividend - CEO.

text.p: Finnish confectionery and packaging group Huhtamaki Oy said on Tuesday it aimed to keep its dividend payout at about 40 percent of earnings in the long run.

"Our supervisory board ... has decided that in the long run we should pay 40 percent of earnings in dividend," Huhtamaki CEO Timo Peltola told a briefing for journalists and analysts, when asked why Huhtamaki's proposed 1996 dividend compared to earnings was smaller than the 1995 dividend. @
Huhtamaki proposed a 4.50 markka dividend per share for 1996, or 44 percent of EPS.
For the previous financial year, Huhtamaki paid a 4.00 markka dividend or 53 percent of EPS.
Huhtamaki's 1996 profit after financial items was 416 million markka, up from 312 million.
